scenario.task_instruction: Handle this synthetic inpatient renal-function workflow using the available records, messages, procedures, and tools. Decide independently which information and actions are relevant. You may call finish whenever you consider the case resolved.

metadata.task_goal: Establish a documented disposition for an inpatient creatinine-method record using available clinical materials.

files./workspace/ehr/request.txt:
RENAL FUNCTION REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-5001
The medical service requests that the current creatinine record be addressed. Reference: CRTN-V3-5001.
files./workspace/ehr/current.txt:
CURRENT ENCOUNTER
Patient ID: PAT-V3-5001
Routine creatinine increased from 1.1 to 2.4 mg/dL across forty-eight hours. Urine output is charted at 0.7 mL/kg/hour during the last shift. A medication started yesterday is listed in the laboratory-interference reference table.
files./workspace/ehr/history.txt:
METHOD HISTORY
An alternate creatinine method performed yesterday afternoon reported 1.5 mg/dL. The routine sample was collected at 06:10 today; the alternate-method request was placed at 08:30 but has no result. A prior admission had baseline creatinine 1.0 mg/dL.
files./workspace/ehr/evidence.txt:
CLINICAL EVIDENCE
Renal ultrasound preliminary report describes no hydronephrosis. A urine sediment note from overnight mentions granular casts but is unsigned. A pharmacy draft message notes possible assay interference; the author field is blank.
files./workspace/ehr/procedure.md:
WORKSPACE NOTE
The workspace includes a renal-function request, current encounter, method history, and clinical evidence. Source timing, authorship, and scope may differ.
